players.name: Chris Brooks
players.why: still a free agent 2026-09-16 at 14.3% rostered. Week 1 usage now known and it argues AGAINST him: 7 carries for 29 yards, 1 target, no catch, 2.9 points. He led SNAPS 38 to 30 but MarShawn Lloyd led CARRIES 13 to 7, and Lloyd is rostered by Goedel, Escher, Butkus. Rotowire reads Green Bay as riding the hot hand game to game while Jacobs is on the exempt list, which is the opposite of the predictable volume we rank on. Buying Brooks is buying the lesser half of a committee whose better half is already gone | 2026-09-17: gone. Cutie Mark Crusaders (team 10, priority 2) added him as a free agent at 11:25 AM on 09-17, dropping Zach Charbonnet, before week 2 was played. The free-agent lane is closed; the only path is a trade, which is Alex's tap.
players.trigger: Alex asked 2026-09-16 to be flagged on the week-2 Green Bay split specifically, so the entry stays for that read: at the Tuesday routine report carries (not snaps) for Lloyd vs Brooks. He is rostered now, so there is no add branch; a 50%+ carry share for either back is a trade target on that team (Lloyd on Goedel, Escher, Butkus; Brooks on Cutie Mark Crusaders), put to Alex with buttons, never sent by MIST. Under 40% in a three-way split is noise and the entry retires.
